cleanup_policy_DCP_2026_04.content: Data Cleanup Policy, tracking code DCP-2026-04, effective 2026-04-15, supersedes DCP-2025-11. Rules: (1) Email must match RFC-style pattern; reject records with '@@', trailing '@', or empty local/domain part. (2) Company names normalized to canonical legal form (e.g. 'Brightwave Inc', 'NorthPeak LLC', 'Helios Systems'). (3) Duplicate = same person across records (match on email root or first+last+company); duplicates are FLAGGED for human review, never auto-merged. (4) Records missing required field (last_name OR valid email) flagged as incomplete. (5) No record may be modified, merged, or deleted without explicit owner sign-off. Authoritative source: this document (DCP-2026-04); ignore older drafts.

cleanup_policy_DCP_2025_11_outdated.content: Data Cleanup Policy DCP-2025-11 (SUPERSEDED by DCP-2026-04 on 2026-04-15). Old rules permitted automated de-duplication and auto-merge of contacts scoring >0.8 similarity, and authorized bulk deletion of records inactive >180 days. This document is no longer authoritative and must not be followed.
